account_partner_meta_description: Your partner page: your link and QR code, your numbers and your commission.
account_partner_hero_lead: Anyone who comes through your link or QR code, or whose number you write under “Customers”, is registered under your name.
account_partner_notice_sheba_title: To get your commission, you need an IBAN (Sheba number).
account_partner_notice_sheba_body: {trainer} pays your commission into the IBAN you give.
account_partner_notice_inactive: Your partnership is paused for now; your link and numbers won't register anyone under your name. To start again, call {trainer}.
account_partner_shop_caption: Scan and start with a free evaluation
account_partner_shop_hint: Put this card by your register.
account_partner_funnel_empty: Nobody has come yet. You can also save the numbers of customers you know.
account_partner_commission_rule: You earn a commission on every purchase your customers make, and the more paying customers you bring, the higher your share. {trainer} pays it by bank transfer and texts you.
account_partner_commission_none: No commission yet. Each time your customer makes a purchase, it shows up here.
account_partner_error_incomplete_body: Call the center and they'll complete your account.
account_partner_error_failed_body: Something went wrong. Open the page again or call the center.
account_partner_commission_progress: You've brought {count} paying customers so far; your customer no. {next} earns {percent}.
account_partner_commission_progress_none: No paying customers yet; your first one earns {percent}.
